items_not_classified_note: The codex's stated total of ~432 includes (a) sub-list items inside Priority tables that share IDs with parent FIXes, (b) preflight FIX-0A through FIX-0G entries which are tracked separately, (c) items absorbed/refuted by later batches without explicit IDs. This file enumerates the 340 distinct FIX-N-X identifiers extracted from the codex headers and tables.
methodology: Static grep/Read verification only. Items confirmed via direct code inspection are marked FIXED or ACTIVE. Items not directly verified in this session are marked UNVERIFIED. Items refuted by codex itself or BATCH14_FINDINGS are marked REFUTED. Codex notes some Batch 9 items as STALE (= already applied prior to verification pass) — those are mapped to FIXED.
